summary: Joe Bevington has just made history as Sandbach United's all-time leading scorer, netting a brace in the Ramblers' last match to surpass James Kirby's previous record of 54 goals in just two seasons at the club. The team are looking to build on that momentum with back-to-back wins as they travel to Foley FC, with a whole season still ahead to add to Joe's impressive tally.
